question: What RNA context do the nine fixed AMPA core/auxiliary sentinel genes provide in the original fibroblast donor/assay/region/protocol strata?
decision: Narrow component/localization follow-up candidates while preserving prior GRIA1 specificity, source labels and functional limits.
strongest_rival: Dropout, assay depth, ambient RNA and source annotation can create isolated or co-detected transcripts without assembled functional receptors.
discriminator: All nine per-stratum count/detection profiles, GRIA1-partner co-detection with all-cell denominators, matched fibroblast donor contrasts and relative-depth sensitivity.
exposure_record: Original GRIA1/SCN7A and neural-context outcomes are exposed. Primary target roles and unique feature IDs were reviewed before partner counts. No new partner values inspected before freeze. This is an exposed extension in the same source lineages.
biological_unit: Original source-identified donors, with cells nested in assay/region/protocol/label strata; cell and nucleus samples can share donors.
nesting_and_overlap: Source donors repeat acrossSS2/10x; external cell/nucleus assays shareA26. Do not count source reanalysis or repeated assays as independent replication.
population_and_selection: Original source lung and external normal/non-Mix selection; six fixed fibroblast/neural-context labels; no target-based label or marker gate. Matched contrast requires both fibroblast labels>=20 cells in the original eligible regions.
contrast: Alveolar-minus-adventitial RNA within donor/assay/region/protocol, then equal-stratum donor averages; neural labels remain anatomically unmatched descriptions.
endpoint: Nine full-library log2(1+CPM) and detection profiles; eight GRIA1-partner co-detection fractions with n_cells denominators; all-depth and within-stratum low/high depth halves.
methods: Reuse only the original hash-bound read-only CSR count reader, with the fixed nine symbols; never call historical main. Save compact per-cell and per-stratum primitives. Verify unique joins, originalGRIA1 primitive/donor parity within1e-10 and co-detection set bounds.
missingness_and_exclusions: Retain all missing-label and low-support attempted pairs with unestimated status. Missing/ambiguous genes, invalid counts/libraries or parity failure stop. No ten-cell relaxation or new neural-exclusion gate.
multiplicity: All nine genes/eight partner pairs, fixed donor strata and depth subsets retained; no inference tests, ranks or selected thresholds.
precision_basis: Descriptive donor/stratum profiles with existing donor support; no power, effect margin, population confidence intervals or cell-level biological replication.
interpretation_limit: Nine sentinel genes are not exhaustive machinery. RNA/co-detection is not protein, receptor assembly/activity, localization or GRIA1 dependence. SS2 uses reads; external assay/protocol labels remain explicit. Relative-depth halves do not depth-match different labels.
stop_rule: Stop on source/hash/mapping/count/identity/parity conflict and retain failed evidence; no target-driven gate or source substitution.
amendment_reason: New separately scoped nine-target partner context; previousGRIA1/SCN7A outputs are reused for parity and remain immutable. Execute in task-ownedX worktree dueC capacity, with identical repository-relative inputs and frozen commit.
